name: exists_clopen_partition_of_clopen_cover
statement: Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [CompactSpace X] [T2Space X] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace X] [Finite I] {Z D : I → Set X} (Z_closed : ∀ i, IsClosed (Z i)) (D_clopen : ∀ i, IsClopen (D i)) (Z_subset_D : ∀ i, Z i ⊆ D i) (Z_disj : univ.PairwiseDisjoint Z) : ∃ C : I → Set X, (∀ i, IsClopen (C i)) ∧ (∀ i, Z i ⊆ C i) ∧ (∀ i, C i ⊆ D i) ∧ (⋃ i, D i) ⊆ (⋃ i, C i) ∧ (univ.PairwiseDisjoint C)
